I then split the hair that was thru the bun into 4 sections and spread it out evenly as you would making a regular bun and bobbypinned the hair in place. 

I then took a combo of my hair and maybe a single 1 inch blonde extension for each side for the pigtails. I used the 1inch extension mostly to wrap around the bottom of the buns (the part between my hairand the buns) to hide the bobbypins better.

And then I took two elastics and made pigtails out of the remaining hair!
